entities.name: Hipólito Ramos
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hipólito Ramos Martínez is a retired boxer from Cuba, who won the silver medal in the Light Flyweight division (-48 kg) at the 1980 Summer Olympics in Moscow. In the final he lost to Shamil Sabirov of the Soviet Union on points (2-3).
